# Paris Fast Transfer (PFT Cabs)

> Paris airport transfer and Paris airport taxi service: private airport taxi and chauffeur transfers between CDG, Orly and Beauvais, Paris, hotels and Disneyland Paris. Online booking, phone and WhatsApp reservations.

Contact: Parisfasttransfer@gmail.com · +33 752 24 44 44 · Customer support is advertised as available 24/7.

## Key facts
- Paris Fast Transfer and PFT Cabs are the same company: a private airport transfer and taxi service in Paris.
- Airports served: Charles de Gaulle (CDG), Orly (ORY) and Beauvais (BVA). Destinations include central Paris, hotels and Disneyland Paris.
- Booking: online form, phone +33 752 24 44 44 or WhatsApp.
- Customer support is advertised as available 24/7. Email: Parisfasttransfer@gmail.com.
- Current prices are published on the taxi rates page.
